app.name: Junior Investor
app.tagline: Learn how great investors think — with virtual money.

lang.chooseTitle: Choose your language / 选择语言
lang.chooseSubtitle: You can change this any time from the top bar.
lang.label: Language

topbar.searchPlaceholder: Search stocks, e.g. AAPL or Apple

search.hint: Type a ticker or company name

onboarding.welcomeText: A calm place for young people to research real companies, talk with AI teaching personas and practise investing with virtual money.
onboarding.parentText: Parents manage learner profiles, limits and resets. Your PIN keeps those settings safe.
onboarding.pinHint: 4–12 digits. You'll need it to manage profiles.
onboarding.childText: Each learner gets their own portfolio, research history and journal.
onboarding.alreadySetUp: This app is already set up. Choose a profile to continue.

family.title: Who's learning today?
family.subtitle: Pick your profile to continue.
family.noProfiles: No learner profiles yet. A parent can create one.

pin.title: Parent PIN
pin.text: Enter the parent PIN to continue.
pin.label: PIN
pin.expired: Parent session expired. Please enter the PIN again.

home.subtitle: What would you like to learn today?
home.welcome: You have {{cash}} in virtual cash. Your goal is not to trade as much as possible — it is to learn how good investors think.
home.askMasterDesc: Chat with AI teaching personas inspired by famous investors.
home.researchStockDesc: Get a sourced report on any US company.
home.makeTradeDesc: Practise with virtual money and write down why.
home.moversEmpty: Your watchlist is empty. Add companies you're curious about.
home.recentResearchEmpty: No research yet. Try researching a company you use every day.

prompts.p1: Why can a great company still be a bad investment at the wrong price?
prompts.p2: Why doesn't profit growth always mean cash-flow growth?
prompts.p3: What makes customers keep coming back to a company instead of its competitors?
prompts.p4: If a stock falls 30%, how would you know whether the business got worse or just the mood changed?
prompts.p5: Why do many investors own several companies instead of just one?
prompts.p6: What is the difference between investing and speculating?

masters.title: Ask a Master
masters.subtitle: AI teaching personas built from publicly documented investment principles. They teach you how to think — they never tell you what to buy.
masters.disclaimer: AI-simulated educational persona based on publicly documented investment principles. Not the real person and not financial advice.

buffett.q1: What is an economic moat? Can you give me an example?
buffett.q2: How do I know if a company is a wonderful business?
buffett.q3: Why do you like holding companies for a long time?

lynch.q1: How can I find good companies from things I use every day?
lynch.q2: What is the PEG ratio and why does it matter?
lynch.q3: What are the different kinds of stocks?

graham.q1: What is the difference between investing and speculating?
graham.q2: What does margin of safety mean?

munger.q1: What is inversion and how can I use it?
munger.q2: Why do incentives matter so much?
munger.q3: What mental models should a young investor learn first?

symbol.q1: What would you want to know before owning {{symbol}}?
symbol.q2: Is {{symbol}} a business I can understand? How do I check?

starters.generic: What should a beginner learn first?

chat.welcome: Ask me anything about investing. I'll explain how I would think about it — I won't tell you what to buy.
chat.modelLoading: The AI model is warming up on your Olares — the first answer can take up to a minute…
chat.reconnecting: Connection dropped — fetching the answer, the server is still working on it…

research.title: Research
research.subtitle: Ask about a company, compare a few, or explore an idea. Every number comes with a source.
research.placeholder: Ticker, company or question — e.g. AAPL
research.inputLabel: What do you want to research?
research.exampleNvidia: 帮我研究一下 Nvidia 为什么赚钱
research.favoritesEmpty: Star a report to keep it here.

report.runningHint: You can leave this page — the report keeps going and will be saved in your history.
report.chartRevenue: Revenue, net income & free cash flow
report.followupPlaceholder: Ask a follow-up question about this report…
report.partial: The data below was gathered, but the written report couldn't be generated.
report.topicNote: This question isn't about one specific company, so this is a topic explainer.

stock.noPosition: You don't own this stock in your simulation.
stock.noResearch: You haven't researched this company yet.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.subtitle: Your simulated portfolio. Virtual money only.
portfolio.concentration: Your largest position, {{symbol}}, is {{pct}} of your portfolio. Many investors spread money across several companies so one surprise can't hurt too much. This is a learning note, not advice.
portfolio.stalePrice: Latest price unavailable — valued at cost
portfolio.empty: No positions yet. Research a company, then try a simulated trade.

trade.title: Simulated trade
trade.qtyWholeInvalid: Please enter a whole number of shares.
trade.whyLabel: Why are you making this trade?
trade.whyPlaceholder: Write your reason in your own words…
trade.guidedHint: Optional, but this is where the real learning happens.

questions.buy_why_own: Why do you want to own this company?
questions.buy_more_valuable: What will make it more valuable?
questions.buy_change_mind: What would make you change your mind?
questions.sell_right_reason: Were you right for the right reason?

trade.noRealMoney: No real money is used. This trade only happens in your practice portfolio.
trade.marketClosed: Market is closed. Simulation uses the latest available price.
trade.journalSaved: Your reasoning was saved to your journal. Come back later to see if you were right for the right reasons.
trade.nudge: Good investors research before they trade. You haven't researched {{symbol}} yet.
trade.notOwned: You don't hold any {{symbol}} shares to sell.
trade.unknownSymbol: We couldn't find a price for {{symbol}}.

watchlist.title: Watchlist
watchlist.subtitle: Companies you're curious about. Watching is a great way to learn before you act.
watchlist.empty: Nothing here yet. Search for a company above to start watching it.

journal.title: Investment journal
journal.subtitle: Write down your thinking. Later you can check if you were right for the right reasons.
journal.empty: No journal entries yet. Every simulated trade asks you to explain your thinking — those notes show up here.

reflect.reflect_differently: What would I do differently next time?

learn.title: Learn
learn.subtitle: Short cards on the ideas every investor needs. Mark them as learned as you go.
learn.askAbout: Can you explain “{{title}}” with an example?

explain.aiUnavailable: The AI helper isn't available right now.

parent.title: Parent dashboard
parent.subtitle: See how each learner is doing and manage their settings.
parent.archiveText: The profile will be hidden. Its history is kept.
parent.resetWarning: All positions will be closed and cash restored to the starting amount. Trade history is kept but a new portfolio period begins. This cannot be undone.
parent.fractionalServerOff: Fractional shares are turned off for this server.

settings.title: Settings
settings.colorConventionHint: Markets use different colors for rising prices.
settings.aboutText: Olares Junior Investor is an education app. All trading is simulated with virtual money — no real money is ever used, and nothing here is investment advice.
settings.aboutMasters: Master personas are AI-simulated teaching characters based on publicly documented investment principles. They are not the real people.
settings.aboutData: Market data can be delayed or unavailable. When data is missing the app says so instead of guessing.

achievement.research: Research complete — you looked at the facts before forming an opinion.
achievement.journal: Journal entry saved — writing down your thinking is what great investors do.
achievement.title: Nice!

disclaimer.app: Simulation only. No real money. Not investment advice.
disclaimer.education: For learning only — not investment advice.

errors.INSUFFICIENT_POSITION: You're trying to sell more shares than you hold ({{held}}).
errors.MARKET_DATA_UNAVAILABLE: Market data is unavailable right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.FRACTIONAL_NOT_ALLOWED: Only whole shares are allowed for this profile.
errors.ETF_NOT_ALLOWED: ETFs are turned off for this profile. A parent can change this.
errors.ASSET_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED: This kind of asset can't be traded in the simulation.
errors.CURRENCY_NOT_SUPPORTED: Only US-dollar stocks can be traded in the simulation.
errors.AI_UNAVAILABLE: The AI helper isn't available right now. Your portfolio and trading still work.
errors.AI_DAILY_LIMIT_REACHED: You've reached today's AI question limit. Come back tomorrow, or read a learning card!
errors.DATA_UNAVAILABLE: We couldn't find data for that company. Check the ticker and try again.
errors.UNKNOWN_SYMBOL: We couldn't find that stock symbol.
errors.QUOTE_TOO_OLD: The latest price is too old to trade on. Please try again later.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.TERM_NOT_FOUND: No glossary entry for this term yet.
errors.ALREADY_SET_UP: This app is already set up.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some of the information isn't valid. Please check and try again.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.UNKNOWN_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.AI_NOT_CONFIGURED: The AI model hasn't been set up yet. A parent can choose one in Settings → AI model.
errors.AI_MODEL_REQUIRED: Please choose or enter a model name.

ai.title: AI model
ai.subtitle: Choose which AI powers the Masters, Research and Explain features: the model running on your Olares, or a cloud AI service.
ai.parentOnly: Only a parent can view or change the AI model.
ai.pinMessage: Enter the parent PIN to manage the AI model.
ai.cloudPrivacyTitle: Your children's questions will be sent to this cloud service
ai.cloudPrivacy: With a cloud model, chat and research prompts leave your Olares and are processed by the provider under its privacy policy and pricing. Portfolios, trades and journals always stay local.
ai.baseUrlHint: The OpenAI-compatible API address, usually ending in /v1.
ai.baseUrlHintLocal: Your Olares model's OpenAI-compatible address, e.g. https://xxxx.yourname.olares.com/v1
ai.urlInvalid: Enter a URL starting with http:// or https://
ai.keyKept: A key is saved ({{hint}}). Leave empty to keep it.
ai.keyRequired: Required for this provider. It is stored only on your Olares and never shown again.
ai.keyOptional: Optional — only if your endpoint requires one.
ai.modelHint: Click “Fetch list” to load the models your key can use, or type the model name.
ai.noModels: The endpoint returned no models — type the model name instead.
ai.temperatureHint: Lower = more careful and consistent. 0.3 is recommended for teaching.
ai.nativeToolsHint: Lets the AI look up live market data itself. Turn off if the model doesn't support tools.
ai.saved: Saved. New conversations use this model right away.
